title: PM congratulates ISRO scientists and engineers on successful launch of GSLV-F18 carrying NVS-03
body_text:
The Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi congratulated India's scientists and engineers at ISRO on the successful launch of GSLV-F18 carrying NVS-03. The Prime Minister said that the mission marks an important step towards strengthening NavIC, India's indigenous satellite navigation system. Equipped with enhanced capabilities, NVS-03 will further advance India's pursuit of self-reliance in critical technologies and strengthen navigation services for the benefit of citizens. Shri Modi lauded the dedication and ingenuity of India's space scientists, stating that their continued achievements make the nation proud. Shri Modi posted on X: Congratulations to our scientists and engineers at ISRO on the successful launch of GSLV-F18 carrying NVS-03. This mission marks an important step in strengthening NavIC, our indigenous satellite navigation system. Equipped with enhanced capabilities, NVS-03 will further our pursuit of self-reliance in critical technologies and support navigation services that benefit our people. The dedication and ingenuity of our space scientists continue to make our nation proud. @isro Congratulations to our scientists and engineers at ISRO on the successful launch of GSLV-F18 carrying NVS-03.

This mission marks an important step in strengthening NavIC, our indigenous satellite navigation system. Equipped with enhanced capabilities, NVS-03 will further our pursuit of self-reliance in critical technologies and support navigation services that benefit our people.

The dedication and ingenuity of our space scientists continue to make our nation proud.
